units.en: all right here's just a quick visual walkthrough for those of you who want to know how to create a new visual studio project that works with masm to do that you're going to go into your solution go up to the top and you're going to add a new project I'm going to make sure that this is just a empty project this particular system has already had the architecture 2001 prerequisites installed on it that's why we see some other stuff but you're looking for empty project then you're going to just call it you know masm test or whatever create
